references.text: Describes the guilt offering with a ram without defect from the flock, the same requirement for the sacrificial animal
Parallel text about bringing a ram without defect as a guilt offering to the priest
Repeats the requirement for a guilt offering with a ram to the priest for atonement
Laws concerning the guilt offering (אָשָׁם) and the priest's role in its handling
Concerns the valuation (עֶרְכְּךָ) that the priest was to determine
A ram as a guilt offering is brought to the priest for atonement
Ezekiel describes the guilt offering in the future temple
Christ as priest has offered one sacrifice for sins, fulfilling the system of the guilt offering
